name: bare-host-row
description: a bare host typed into the palette must be offered as something to open. command-bar already proves the path for a FULL url - it types http://127.0.0.1:8000/peek-target.html and Return opens it - so a bare host is the one input left unmeasured, and it is the input the reporter used. The gate is the bridge's own results line: the query length says the text arrived, the results line says what came back, and an empty answered pass is the failure the reporter sees as a blank list.

actions.note: GATE: the app started and reached a committed page.
the reserved chrome context lands about 670ms after startup and the palette's WebContents needs it.
let the /commandbar document load and announce itself
THE MEASUREMENT. A finished pass that carries at least one row. Zero here is the reporter's blank list, and it fails loud instead of looking like a key that went missing.
Return accepted the row and opened a tab. The url is not gated: the VM may have no route to google.com, and whether the page loads is not what this scenario measures.

assertions.desc: and it was responsive enough to quit on Cmd+Q
